items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: I met Far Taken Sick. ! She named Josie.

ctx.x: Where would they work? In a band or did they work in the bar rooms?

They worked in different bands. Well, I mean, you know bands, but they ain't like theirs now, you see. Yeah, I understand. But they scattered around, you see. But most of them, most of them parties, see. People in the other days used to just have a party and hire piano players to play, you know, like that. Before the band thing got out, you know, like there, see. Then there's a girl right here now. I met Far Taken Sick. ! She named Josie. Josie. Yeah, Josie. She's living over the river. She's a little slender,…
I'd like to hear her. She's still here, isn't she?
